entities.name: Medge
entities.description: A venerable merfolk teacher of the Simic Combine on Ravnica who is mutated by a cytoplast accident and favors traditional merfolk ways.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose bioengineering shapes merfolk society and the mutations seen in the story.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane whose underwater world beneath the streets is home to the merfolk.

entities.name: Kaszira
entities.description: A reserved but observant merfolk student of Medge who deduces how long the monk has meditated and wants to study in the zonots.

entities.name: Ptero Zallik
entities.description: A rival teacher with heavily modified and numerous students who later reconciles with Medge.

entities.name: Andrik
entities.description: The ghost, sole survivor of a sunken upworld ship, who is later revealed to have a sinister true form.

entities.name: Miko
entities.description: A student who tries to open the chest and later accidentally drops a cytoplast on Medge.

entities.name: Chessa
entities.description: A brave student who takes the medallion from the chest and tricks a krasis into swallowing it.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: Kaszira's influential aunt, a Utopian Speaker, whose intervention frees the class.

entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: A historic figure in Simic Combine lore whose lost keyrune is among the recovered artifacts.

entities.name: Zonot Five
entities.description: An upworlder sinkhole where the ghost's ship is brought.

entities.name: Adaptationists
entities.description: Proponents of the newer bioengineered approaches within the Simic Combine.

events.summary: Medge's students, led by her, discover an elder monk in deep meditation; Kaszira deduces from the plankton layers that his trance has lasted seven weeks.
events.quote: Kaszira, a reserved but observant student, deduced it to be seven weeks

events.summary: Ptero Zallik flaunts his heavily modified students, heightening Medge's worry about dwindling students and fierce competition for protectorate positions.
events.quote: The competition for limited protectorate positions was fierce, and Medge worried about the future.

events.summary: Medge takes her students to observe a krasis, which brutally attacks a resplendent benthid; they then hear a ghostly voice from a shipwreck.
events.quote: They witnessed the krasis brutally attack a resplendent benthid

events.summary: They meet the ghost Andrik, who wants his crew's remains buried on the surface; Medge decides to help and they make the wreck buoyant and hide it from krasis.
events.quote: Despite the risks, Medge decided to help

events.summary: The students bring the ship to the zonot, where the ghost reveals his sinister form; Miko opens the chest, a fight follows, and Chessa tricks a krasis into swallowing the medallion, destroying the ghost.
events.quote: led the ghost to his demise by tricking a krasis into swallowing it

events.summary: The group presents the recovered Simic artifacts, including the lost keyrune of Momir Vig, to the zonot's guardians and tours a museum.
events.quote: the lost keyrune of Momir Vig

events.summary: Miko accidentally causes a cytoplast to fall on Medge, starting her mutation; the class is imprisoned and then released through Zegana's intervention.
Medge advocates for her students, who are allowed to pursue their dreams; Kaszira gets to study in the zonots and Medge reconciles with Ptero to train protectors together.

relations.note: Medge is a teacher in the guild.
relations.quote: Medge is a mutated merfolk teacher, part of the Simic Combine

relations.note: Kaszira is one of Medge's students.
relations.quote: a group of students under the guidance of Tender Medge
